comments.text: I’m going to assume that you’re going to be either on a yacht or charter boat. I love Navy, White and Khaki. Now if you’re on a yacht? Switch out the striped shirt for a simple White Oxford. If it’s a charter boat, loose the blazer, keep the striped shirt if it’s long sleeve, if not , again, a long sleeve, White Oxford or a linen long sleeve shirt in Navy with a white t-shirt showing 2 buttons off the top and to finish it off, a Ralph Lauren baseball cap in Navy or a New York Yankees baseball cap in Navy (or Red for that pop of color). This way, the nautical and preppy vibe is kept, but much simpler. Anyhow, thanks for sharing. Keep doing what you’re doing.
comments.author: @christophermoody1448
